lessons.title: Hello! Nice to meet you
lessons.goal_uz: Darsdan so'ng siz salomlasha olasiz, ismingizni va qayerdan ekaningizni ayta olasiz.

steps.title: At the language school
steps.context_uz: Aziz til maktabida yangi guruhdoshi Anna bilan tanishmoqda.

lines.en: Hi! I'm Anna. What's your name?
Hello, Anna. My name is Aziz.
Nice to meet you, Aziz. Where are you from?
I'm from Samarkand, in Uzbekistan. And you?
I'm from London. Are you a student?
Yes, I am. I'm a student at the university.
Me too! Nice to meet you.

steps.body_uz:
O'zbek tilida "Men talabaman" deymiz — fe'l yo'q. Ingliz tilida esa gapda albatta **to be** fe'li bo'ladi:
**I am** (I'm) · **you / we / they are** (you're) · **he / she / it is** (he's, she's).
So'roq gapda fe'l oldinga chiqadi: **Are you** a student? — **Yes, I am.**

steps.q: Anna: "Nice to meet you!" — What is a good answer?
steps.explain_uz: Tanishuvga javoban "Nice to meet you too!" deyiladi.

steps.say: Hi, I'm Anna. I'm from London.

steps.explain_uz: Ingliz tilida "u" — he (erkak) yoki she (ayol). Kasb oldidan **a** qo'yiladi.

steps.text: Hello! My name is Aziz. Nice to meet you.

steps.prompt_uz: O'zingizni 2–3 gapda tanishtiring: ismingiz, qayerdansiz, talaba yoki ishlaysizmi.
steps.prompt: Introduce yourself: your name, where you are from, and if you are a student.
steps.example: Hello! My name is Malika. I'm from Namangan. I'm a student at the university.

lessons.title: This is my family
lessons.goal_uz: Oila a'zolaringizni tanishtira olasiz va my / your / his / her so'zlarini to'g'ri ishlatasiz.

steps.title: Dilnoza's family photo
steps.text: Hi! I'm Dilnoza and this is my family. This is my father. His name is Rustam and he is a doctor. This is my mother, Gulnora. She is a teacher. I have one brother and one sister. My brother is twenty-five years old. He is married and he has two children. My sister, Madina, is very young — she is ten. Her favourite colour is pink!
steps.uz: Salom! Men Dilnozaman va bu mening oilam. Bu mening otam. Uning ismi Rustam, u shifokor. Bu onam, Gulnora. U o'qituvchi. Mening bitta akam va bitta singlim bor. Akam yigirma besh yoshda. U uylangan va ikki farzandi bor. Singlim Madina juda yosh — u o'n yoshda. Uning sevimli rangi pushti!

steps.explain_uz: "His name is Rustam and he is a doctor."

steps.title_uz: Egalik: my, your, his, her, our, their
steps.body_uz:
O'zbekchada qo'shimcha qo'shamiz: oila**m**, oila**ngiz**. Ingliz tilida so'z oldidan alohida so'z qo'yiladi:
**I → my** · **you → your** · **he → his** · **she → her** · **we → our** · **they → their**.
Yosh aytish: **He is 20 years old.** ("have" emas, **be** ishlatiladi!)

examples.en: Her sister is ten years old.

steps.q: This is Rustam. ___ son is a teacher.
Malika is my friend. ___ mother is a doctor.

steps.explain_uz: Yosh aytilganda **be** fe'li: is. "has 12 years" — xato!

answer: My father is forty years old
My dad is forty years old

steps.text: This is my mother. Her name is Gulnora.

steps.prompt_uz: Oilangiz haqida 3–4 gap yozing: kim bor, ismlari, yoshlari, kasblari.
steps.prompt: Write about your family: who is in it, their names, ages and jobs.
steps.example: There are five people in my family. My father's name is Bahodir. He is a driver. My mother is a nurse. I have one sister. She is fifteen years old.

lessons.title: My day
lessons.goal_uz: Kundalik ishlaringizni Present Simple'da aytasiz va vaqtni so'ray olasiz.

words.ex: My mother goes to work by bus.
I never watch TV in the morning.

steps.title: Jasur's day
steps.text: Jasur is a student. He gets up at seven o'clock every day. He has breakfast with his family — he always drinks green tea. He goes to university by metro. His classes start at nine. After classes, he usually plays football with his friends. In the evening, he does his homework and studies English for thirty minutes. He never goes to bed late.
steps.uz: Jasur talaba. U har kuni soat yettida turadi. Oilasi bilan nonushta qiladi — har doim ko'k choy ichadi. Universitetga metroda boradi. Darslari soat to'qqizda boshlanadi. Darslardan keyin odatda do'stlari bilan futbol o'ynaydi. Kechqurun uy vazifasini qiladi va o'ttiz daqiqa ingliz tili o'rganadi. U hech qachon kech yotmaydi.

steps.q: How does Jasur go to university?
What does he do in the evening?
steps.explain_uz: "In the evening, he does his homework..."

steps.body_uz:
Har kuni, odatda takrorlanadigan ishlar uchun **Present Simple** ishlatiladi.
**I / you / we / they + fe'l:** I get up at 7.
**he / she / it + fe'l + s:** He get**s** up at 7. (go → go**es**, do → do**es**, have → **has**)
Inkor: I **don't** drink coffee. · He **doesn't** drink coffee.
So'roq: **Do** you work? · **Does** she work?
**always / usually / never** fe'ldan oldin turadi: I **usually** walk.

examples.en: Do you have breakfast at home?
I never go to bed late.

steps.q: My father ___ to work at eight.

steps.text: She ___ drink coffee. She drinks tea.
steps.uz: U qahva ichmaydi. U choy ichadi.

steps.answer: I usually get up at seven

answer: He goes to work by bus
He goes to work by bus.

steps.q: What time does she get up?
steps.say: My sister gets up at half past six, but I get up at eight.

steps.text: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast with my family.

steps.prompt_uz: Odatiy kuningizni 4–5 gapda yozing. always / usually / never so'zlarini ishlating.
steps.prompt: Describe your typical day. Use always, usually and never.
steps.example: I usually get up at half past six. I always have breakfast with my family. Then I go to work by bus. In the evening I cook dinner and watch a film. I never go to bed after midnight.
